messages.subject: LAST MINUTE REMINDER: Davis R Users Group meeting at 10am today
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

This is a late reminder that we are having our first meeting of the Fall quarter today at 10 am (that's in about 45 minutes!) Join us in person or virtually. The physical location is the DataLab classroom (aka 360 Shields library) and the Zoom link is https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/95954035889

I'll have a brief presentation to (re)introduce the group, and then we will have time for a work session where folks can get help with R questions.

See you soon!
-Wes
